headline: Revenue and earnings grow y/y; profit eases q/q
summary_short: BNY's Q3 2026 revenue was $5.68B (+12% y/y) and diluted EPS $2.34 (+24% y/y, -4% q/q); pre-tax margin was 38.5% and ROTCE 29.0%.
summary_long: Fee revenue rose 12% y/y to $4.08B and net interest income rose 15% to $1.42B, while noninterest expense grew 8%. Net income to common was $1.61B. Sequentially, EPS fell from $2.45 as taxes rose and expenses grew 1%. Assets under custody and administration reached $63.4T. The CET1 ratio was 10.9% and the Tier 1 leverage ratio 5.7%. BNY returned $1.4B to common shareholders, including $937M of buybacks. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Shard EPS of 2.37 is adjusted (excluding notable items); GAAP diluted EPS is $2.34. Y/y and q/q changes are as stated in the release.

drivers.explanation: Fee revenue rose on net new business, higher client activity and higher market values, partly offset by AUM flow mix.
Reinvestment of securities at higher yields and balance sheet growth, partly offset by deposit margin compression.
CEO cited broad-based platform growth, healthy sales and pipelines, and operating leverage.
